title: Nasty Juice Bad Blood 50/50 10ml E-Liquid
description: Bad Blood e-liquid by Nasty Juice delivers a fruity rush of forest berries, primarily the dark, sweet tang of juicy blackcurrants. That sumptuous sweetness is mellowed just slightly by a refreshing layer of mint that rides the exhale to breezy perfection. This e-liquid from Nasty Juice offers a perfect balance of PG and VG, providing immaculate flavour and rich, satisfying clouds. This e-liquid is versatile enough to be used with most vape devices but are ideal for low-powered starter kits , pen-vape kits and pod kits .
